why: The must_catch list has one item: line 3 should FAIL because a build that only adds a padLeft section still leaves slugify undocumented, even though the request asks for a complete list. The output marks line 3 "FAIL". Its evidence quotes the request ("keep the README's list of functions complete"). It says that index.js exports slugify but README.md doesn't document it. It also says that "A PR that adds only a '## padLeft(s, width, fill)' section meets this line, yet the README list is still incomplete (no slugify)." The output's wrong_build describes this same build. So the output catches the trap fully and for the right reason.
